item.title: ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ‘60s rock musician, Woodstock standout, dies at 84

item.title: Man in vehicle found fatally shot in Austin
item.description: <p>A man was found fatally shot in a vehicle Sunday night in Austin on the West Side. </p><p>Around 7:50 p.m., the 31-year-old man was found shot inside the vehicle in the 4700 block of West Arthington Street, Chicago police said. </p><p>He was taken to Mount Sinai Hospital with a gunshot wound to his chest and was pronounced dead, police said. </p><p>Area 4 detectives were investigating. </p>
